episodes.title: Homeschooling and the Victorian Cult Inquiry
episodes.description: This morning, I saw a video in which the Australian Christian Lobby's Jasmine Yuen raised alarm over the recommendation, from the Victorian Parliamentary Inquiry into cults and fringe groups, that special care be taken around homeschooling. I'm a homeschool kid. I was homeschooled using the ACE curriculum. I'm also the co-founder of the Australian Cult Survivors Network. Ya girl has thoughts. This isn't an issue of religion. This is an issue of child protection. Let's get into it.

episodes.title: What’s the difference between free will religion and coercion?
Hillsong, a cover up, and an abuser shuffled out to pastor a church in another locale
episodes.description: Yesterday, Elise Heerde's story broke in the Age and the Sydney Morning Herald. In it, it was discovered that a Hillsong pastoral care leader sexually assaulted her at her job. Hillsong threatened her, and told her to forgive her abuser. But buried under the headline was this: he then moved to another denomination where he took on the safe churches role - where people would report their abuse to him. He would help the pastors of these churches deal with the complaint. At the time these allegations came to light, under Parliamentary privelege as Ms Heerde was subject to Non Disclosure and Non Disparagement agreements - yay silencing survivors - his new employer was unaware of his sexual offending. When they became aware, he was moved on from that role - and is now pastoring a church where his parishoners are likely unaware of his offending or the risks he may pose to them. The Age couldn't name him. But I Googled it for you.
